eyebrow: What disks and partitions actually exist
code:
$ lsblk
NAME   SIZE TYPE MOUNTPOINT
sda     40G disk
├─sda1  39G part /
sdb    100G disk
└─sdb1 100G part

$ sudo blkid /dev/sdb1
/dev/sdb1: UUID="7a3f21b0-..." TYPE="ext4"
caption: sdb1 exists but has no mountpoint yet — it isn't attached anywhere

eyebrow: Attach a filesystem to a directory
caption: The mount point must already exist before mount will attach the filesystem
UUID never changes even if the device name shifts; mount -a validates before reboot
